record.bible_text: Judge<WH08199><WTH8798> me, O God<WH0430>, and plead<WH07378><WTH8798> my cause<WH07379> against an ungodly<WH03808><WH02623> nation<WH01471>: O deliver<WH06403><WTH8762> me from the deceitful<WH04820> and unjust<WH05766> man<WH0376>. <RF>ungodly: or, unmerciful<Rf> <RF>the deceitful...: Heb. a man of deceit and iniquity<Rf>

For thou <FI>art<Fi> the God<WH0430> of my strength<WH04581>: why dost thou cast me off<WH02186><WTH8804>? why go<WH01980><WTH8691> I mourning<WH06937><WTH8802> because of the oppression<WH03906> of the enemy<WH0341><WTH8802>?

O send out<WH07971><WTH8798> thy light<WH0216> and thy truth<WH0571>: let them lead<WH05148><WTH8686> me; let them bring<WH0935><WTH8686> me unto thy holy<WH06944> hill<WH02022>, and to thy tabernacles<WH04908>.

Then will I go<WH0935><WTH8799> unto the altar<WH04196> of God<WH0430>, unto God<WH0410> my exceeding<WH08057> joy<WH01524>: yea, upon the harp<WH03658> will I praise<WH03034><WTH8686> thee, O God<WH0430> my God<WH0430>. <RF>my exceeding...: Heb. the gladness of my joy<Rf>

Why art thou cast down<WH07817><WTH8709>, O my soul<WH05315>? and why art thou disquieted<WH01993><WTH8799> within me? hope<WH03176><WTH8685> in God<WH0430>: for I shall yet praise<WH03034><WTH8686> him, <FI>who is<Fi> the health<WH03444> of my countenance<WH06440>, and my God<WH0430>.<CM>
